thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert — SEV2 latency spike on api.redwood.com (region: us-west-2). p95 > 2s, error rate elevated. Triggered at 2026-03-12 01:13:20 UTC
mira: I'm oncall, looking at metrics now. Not seeing 5xx in the gateway yet. Starting tcpdump on ingress and tailing runtime logs.
owen: I can pull model-pool logs and GPU metrics if you want. Send the job id or a log window.
mira: job id: 0x7f9c2a — dumping last 5m. snippet below:
```
2026-03-12T01:12:55Z WARN kv-cache miss for model gpt-medium
2026-03-12T01:13:02Z ERROR runtime: kernel launch timeout on gpu-3
2026-03-12T01:13:07Z WARN routing: queue depth spike -> routed to cold-variant
```
jasper: looks like a caching/eviction cascade + kernel hiccup. checking autoscaler events.
mira: autoscaler shows a transient scale-down at 01:11 due to a failed readiness probe; pods restarted 01:12:30 which coincides with the spike.
owen: found correlated kernel OOM on gpu-3 in /var/log/nvidia; the quantized kernel failed to allocate while the process was restarted.
mira: mitigation plan: 1) drain gpu-3, 2) migrate live traffic to compatible variant (gpt-medium-quant2), 3) increase cache TTL to avoid thrash. Executing now.
pm-lucas: @mira please note impacted customers: Acme Corp and LambdaRetail on hosted endpoints. I'm pinging accounts and opening support tickets.
kelly: are we seeing user-facing errors or retries? any SLO breaches logged?
mira: p50 recovered by 01:14:40 after traffic migration, p95 still elevated until 01:16:05. Customers reported slow webhook responses for ~3 minutes.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated to SEV2 by mira at 2026-03-12T01:14:20Z
jasper: handoff: mira -> owen at 01:17 for root-cause deeper analysis, I'll keep an eye on the metrics. owen taking lead.
owen: bridge open. initial hypothesis: 1) autoscaler probe mis-evaluated readiness causing restart, 2) quantization kernel allocation failure on gpu-3, 3) cache TTL too short leading to eviction storm.
pm-lucas: customer impact summary: Acme saw ~15 failed requests (support #ACME-498); LambdaRetail saw elevated latency (support #LAMBDA-721). CSMs alerted.
kelly: proposing postmortem slot Monday 12:00 PT — SRE, runtime, autoscaler, and product should join. ok?
jasper: Monday works for me.
owen: I'm available.
mira: added a short timeline to the incident doc and flagged key logs. I'll draft the RCA skeleton tonight and post a draft tomorrow morning.
sre-lead: for the postmortem please include: timeline, immediate mitigations, contributing factors, root cause hypothesis, action items with owners and due dates, customer impact summary, and verification plan.
mira: draft RCA outline (added to doc):
- Detection 01:13:20 — incident-bot alert (p95 > 2s)
- Paging 01:13:25 — oncall paged
- Mitigation start 01:13:45 — drain + migrate traffic away from gpu-3
- Primary mitigation 01:14:40 — traffic migrated; p50 improved
- Recovery 01:16:10 — p95 restored to baseline
- Root cause hypothesis 01:20:00 — autoscaler readiness probe false-negative + quant kernel allocation failure

owen: I'll add kernel logs, repro steps, and a minimal reproducer in a sandbox.
kelly: action items to track: 
1) Autoscaler readiness probe tuning + integration test (owner: eng-ml; due: 2026-03-26)
2) Kernel allocation safety check + fallback path (owner: eng-runtime; due: 2026-03-19)
3) Increase cache TTL defaults + run stress test (owner: eng-platform; due: 2026-03-22)
4) Customer outreach summary and post-incident note (owner: pm-lucas; due: 2026-03-13)
mira: I'll own the incident writeup first draft — aiming to post by 2026-03-13 08:00 PT for peer review.
pm-lucas: will coordinate the customer note with support and CSMs.
sre-lead: peer reviewers: jasper, kelly, owen. please review within 48h of the draft posting.
mira: draft link posted: https://internal.redwood/doc/incident/1767777000/rca-draft (internal)
jasper: small add: include a canary step for the kernel fallback change before global rollout — add as a subtask.
owen: added subtask 'canary-fallback-test' (owner: eng-runtime; due: 2026-03-18).
kelly: recording assignments to incident tracker and creating follow-up ticket in Jira.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by owen at 2026-03-12T01:18:12Z — severity returned to normal. Duration ~5m.
mira: thanks everyone. Postmortem Monday; ping here if you need help with the draft or can't make the review window. :thumbsup:
